profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Apple Cloud Security
profile.summary:
- High impactful engineer and leader in strategizing and implementing large scale, low latency platforms and security applications
- Relentless focus in engineering solutions for tough problems at both speed and scale
- Passion for everything security and data
- Designed and developed multiple security use cases : Breach prevention & detection, privacy protocols using advanced cryptographic techniques, Account compromise Detection & Prevention and Anomaly detections using deep learning & graph analytics on very large datasets
- Expert in large scale data and distributed technologies for stream processing, batch and graph analytics (Spark, Scala, S3, C*, Hadoop)
- Proven track record in implementing multiple challenging use cases on distributed computation and datastore platforms
- Extensive hands-on experience in multiple disciplines using languages : Java, Scala, Python, Groovy
- Skilled in cloud technologies making large scale apps run efficiently at scale
- Strong interpersonal skills, capability of working with cross functional teams and varying levels of management
- Evangelized engineering hygiene and best practices across the organization
- Self driven in executing product lifecycle right from inception through making it fully operational at scale 

Specialities:
Everything Security | Everything Data | Distributed Computing and Storage | Anomaly detections | Network Security | Privacy Protocols | Application Security | Resiliency | Cloud Computing | Low Latency and Scale
